chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). He said:

I asked him about the cesspool that is above the well. He said: When it is above the well, then seven cubits [must separate them]; and when it is lower than the well, then five cubits from every direction — and that is sufficient.

key_terms.أَذْرُع: adhru' (pl. of dhira') — cubits, a traditional unit of length approximately equal to the length of the forearm (roughly 45–50 cm)
key_terms.الْبَالُوعَة: balu'a — cesspool or drainage pit, a pit that collects wastewater or sewage
key_terms.الْبِئْر: bi'r — a well dug into the ground for drawing water, typically used for drinking and ritual purity
key_terms.نَاحِيَة: nahiya — direction, side; 'from every direction' means the measurement applies in all directions, not just one

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum distance required between a cesspool and a well according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a jurisprudential ruling on the minimum permissible distance between a cesspool (balu'a) and a well to prevent contamination of the well water. The Imam specifies that if the cesspool is positioned higher (upstream in the water table) than the well, seven cubits distance is required; but if lower (downstream), five cubits from every side suffices. This reflects the Imam's awareness of how groundwater flows, since a higher cesspool poses greater contamination risk than a lower one.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Hassan Bin Rabaat, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the gutter which happens to be higher than the well. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it was higher than the well, so there should be seven cubits (distance between the two); and when it was lower than the well, so five cubits from every direction, and that is sufficient’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Hassan ibn Ribat who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about a cesspool which is above a well. He (the Imam) said, ‘If it is above the well, the distance in between must be seven yards, but if it is below the well, the distance must be five yards from all sides, and that is a large area.”
